tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The entire work intended to tender is of confidential in nature. Hence the absolute confidentiality should be maintained

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have experience in the field of security printing/ Over printing variable data for 7 lakh quantity in any one of the past 3 years
Bidder should have executed print and supply of Marks Cards & Certificates up to at least variable data over printing to any Govt/Universities/institutions
The Tenderer should be a single business entity and may either be a proprietorship Firm, or partnership firm, or company
Factory license and license to print the certificates from the competent authority has to be uploaded
The tenderer should be empaneled as Security Printers in Indian Bank Association (IBA) in respect with the printing Unit (Tenderers applied & waiting for the IBA empanelment are not considered
Copy of PAN card of the firm has to be uploaded
Details of Income tax return field for the year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 i.e., assessment Year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 respectively
The tenderer have GST number and retuned file of the 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 year
The tenderer must be ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 Certificates Company
The tenderer shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility / blacklisted for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by State/Central Government or any other statutory bodies.
Average Turnover of the tenderer shall not be less than Rs.2 Crore in the financial year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25
